Mina/Laura/Marcus —

I reviewed draft_remediation_notice_v1.docx and attached a redlined copy (redlines_remediation_notice.docx) with comments. High-level legal guidance:

- Replace any absolute language ("will be terminated on X date") with conditional phrasing ("may be subject to further disciplinary action, up to and including termination, depending on progress").
- Avoid listing speculative performance consequences tied to non-clocked dates; instead use milestone-based checkpoints (e.g., review at 30 days, 60 days).
- Keep obligations for manager to provide "reasonable opportunity and resources" — this reduces exposure.
- Preserve employee privacy in the notice, avoid excessive operational detail; keep any attachments (coaching log) summarized rather than embedded.

Also flagged a small confidentiality note about copying non-essential personnel. Jordan (cc’d on initial thread) should be excluded from the final distribution list unless needed.

I do not think DocuSign is necessary for this internal notice; a signed acknowledgement captured via HR case record is sufficient. If you want eSignature, let me know the business reason.

Markus Klein
Associate General Counsel
